title: Haze: 16 areas record unhealthy API readings as at 9am, Johan Setia highest at 160 - The Edge Malaysia
text:
Haze: 16 areas record unhealthy API readings as at 9am, Johan Setia highest at 160 Friday 23 Oct 2026 BURSA SGX Home 
 Make The Edge Malaysia your preferred source on Google KUALA LUMPUR (Oct 23): A total of 16 areas nationwide recorded unhealthy air quality as at 9am on Friday, with Johan Setia in Selangor registering the highest air pollutant index (API) reading of 160.
 According to the Department of Environment's (DOE) Air Pollutant Index Management System (APIMS) portal, four other areas in Selangor also recorded unhealthy API readings, namely Klang (159), Petaling Jaya (155), Shah Alam (155) and Banting (153).
 In Negeri Sembilan, Seremban recorded an API reading of 158, followed by Nilai at 157. Putrajaya registered 152, while Batu Muda in Kuala Lumpur recorded 158 and Cheras 120.
 In Melaka, the affected areas were Bukit Rambai (151), Melaka City (129) and Alor Gajah (113). In Johor, Batu Pahat recorded 152 and Tangkak 135, while Sri Aman in Sarawak registered 152.
 Meanwhile, 50 areas nationwide recorded moderate air quality, while two recorded good air quality.
 An API reading of zero to 50 indicates good air quality, 51 to 100 moderate, 101 to 200 unhealthy, 201 to 300 very unhealthy, and readings above 300 hazardous.
